FixtureOriginalReadersEmpty.description: True only if the named owned child is sealing and has no creation-bound original-read operation; false means operations remain; null means the child is not sealed or is invalid.

x-scope: Private fixture owner in the verified disposable database only; not a Media or Images runtime API.
x-status-privileges: The Assets NOLOGIN owner owns this function. PUBLIC and ordinary runtime roles have no execute grant; only the private fixture migration/database owner is granted execute.

x-notification.channel: aap_fixture_reader_ followed by the lowercase run UUID without hyphens
x-notification.delivery: The common Assets finish emits only after its exact operation deletion succeeds, in the same transaction; PostgreSQL delivers on commit.
x-notification.authority: A notification is only a wakeup. A fresh status and the unchanged final retirement guard remain authoritative.
